central_hypothesis: A common parameterized critical-function structure, not a common raw constant, predicts information-limited and mismatch-limited task failure in independently formulated heterogeneous UAV, vehicle and motor models.
claim_boundary: author-defined heterogeneous computational causal validation; not official source-controller replay, HIL, hardware or physical intervention

uav6dof.state: 3D position, 3D velocity, Euler attitude, body-rate and battery proxy
uav6dof.heterogeneity: mass, drag, thrust reserve, attitude bandwidth and sensor bias

vehicle.state: longitudinal position, speed and actuator acceleration
vehicle.heterogeneity: mass-normalized authority, drag, actuator lag, sensing bias and braking reserve

motor.heterogeneity: resistance, inductance, inertia, damping, torque constant and load torque

heldout_condition_design: For every size, topology and rho, held-out seed j deterministically selects visibility[j mod 3], heterogeneity[(2j+1) mod 3] and fault[j mod 4]; this mapping is shared by all policies.

critical_function.success_rule: predicted feasible iff upper confidence envelope of Psi is <= 1
